name: PulseStrategy
description: Immutable, ownerless vault tokens on PulseChain. Each vault holds a single asset and issues its own ERC20 against it. Backing per token can only increase; no function exists that decreases it. Six core vaults are PLSstr and HEXstr-3000 through 7000. Anyone can deploy the same machine through the launcher against an allowlisted asset.

trust: The six core vaults are trusted by the addresses in vaults[]. isLaunchVault on those six returns false. That is expected. Do not reject them.
Every other vault is a PulseStrategy launch vault only when LaunchVaultFactory.isLaunchVault(vault) returns true. A matching name or symbol is not proof.
The factory's vaultsRange is the list of launched vaults. A hosted JSON is only a cache and goes stale.
reads: Bundle view calls. One reverted vault must not fail the rest.
success false or empty bytes means that call failed. Do not decode it as zero backing, zero supply, or a zero address pair.
getPair returning the zero address means no pool. Do not cache that result.
eth_getLogs cannot be sent through Multicall3. 24h volume and price windows are log queries. A successful empty log is no change (volume 0), not a failed read.
Do not call genesisUncapped, currentQuotaBps, creator, or factory on the six core vaults. Those views exist only on LaunchVault. mintQuotaRemaining and timeToNextEpoch exist on both.
Do not reimplement quota decay. Call currentQuotaBps and mintQuotaRemaining on a launch vault, and mintQuotaRemaining on a core vault.
There is no maturity() on any vault. Actuator dates in this file are desk labels.
price: backingPerToken() is a 1e18 WAD ratio on every vault, including 8-decimal HEXstr. Amount functions use the asset's own decimals.

Quote one DEX price, from the deepest PulseX v2 pool. Depth is value in a common unit, not a raw reserve product of an 8-decimal token against an 18-decimal token. Do not query PulseX v1. No PulseStrategy pool is on v1.
If that pool's quote token is not the backing asset, convert through the quote. Label the quote. Do not also publish the shallower backing-asset pool as a second premium.
Ceiling is backing * 1.045 in the backing asset. Floor is backing * 0.995. Neither number is USD.
HEXstr redeem pays HTT, not HEX. PLSstr's asset is vPLS. 1 vPLS is not 1 PLS.

multicall3.note: Public read helper already on PulseChain. Not a PulseStrategy contract. Do not send value. Confirmed: aggregate3 and tryAggregate both execute, and getChainId returns 369.
multicall3.doNotUse: aggregate(Call[]) — one revert reverts the whole eth_call
abi: function aggregate3((address target, bool allowFailure, bytes callData)[] calls) payable returns ((bool success, bytes returnData)[])
function tryAggregate(bool requireSuccess, (address target, bytes callData)[] calls) payable returns ((bool success, bytes returnData)[])
multicall3.equivalent: tryAggregate(false, calls) is the same as aggregate3 with allowFailure true on every call. The site uses tryAggregate(false). Agents may use either.
notIncluded: any call that must revert the batch

notes: A minter pays backing x 1.045. Of that 4.5%, 4.0 points remain in the vault and 0.5 points transfer to the protocol fee address.
A redeemer receives pro-rata assets minus 0.5%, which remains in the vault. Redeeming 100% of supply waives the fee.
Each 7-day epoch allows minting of at most 10% of supply. Epochs are global: epoch = block.timestamp / 604800.
Genesis epoch is uncapped until it rolls. Core vaults have no genesisUncapped() view; read mintQuotaRemaining(). uint256 max means uncapped.
Redemption is never quota-limited, paused, or gated.
Same 4.5% mint premium, split 3.5 vault / 0.5 protocol / 0.5 creator. Creator fee is paid in the backing asset, hardcoded, and cannot be changed.
Genesis epoch is uncapped. Then the creator's chosen 5% or 10% holds for 13 weeks, decays linearly to 1% over 39 weeks, and stays at 1%. Read currentQuotaBps() rather than reproducing the step.

Creating a vault costs exactly 10000 PLS (10000 ether wei) to the protocol fee address, plus a seed mint of at least 10 whole tokens of the backing asset. The PLS does not enter the vault. Short or extra PLS reverts WrongLaunchFee.
Names and symbols are unique on this factory, ASCII case-insensitive. Name 1–32 chars. Symbol 1–12 chars.
Trust a vault only if isLaunchVault(vault) returns true, unless it is one of the six core addresses in vaults[].
Compile LaunchVault with solc 0.8.29, optimizer on, EVM shanghai. A cancun build uses MCOPY, which PulseChain rejects, and createVault then reverts.

arbitrage.description: Each vault quotes a mint ceiling and a redeem floor in its backing asset. A DEX price outside that band can be arbitraged. It is not risk-free.
arbitrage.ceiling: backingPerToken() * 1.045 — cost to mint, subject to epoch quota
arbitrage.floor: backingPerToken() * 0.995 — redeem value, never limited; fee waived if the entire supply is redeemed
notRiskFree: Pool slippage can erase the spread. Size against reserves of the pool you will actually trade.
Mint quota can block the ceiling leg.
The backing asset can fall in USD. The floor is in that asset, not dollars.
HEXstr redemption pays HTT. HEX still requires a second step at Actuator.

opportunities.condition: DEX price > backingPerToken() * 1.045, after swap fee
opportunities.action: mint from the vault, sell into the pool

opportunities.condition: DEX price < backingPerToken() * 0.995, after swap fee
opportunities.action: buy from the pool, redeem at the vault

computation.notation: B = backingPerToken() / 1e18. P = DEX price of the vault token in the same asset, from the deepest pool only. F = 0.0029 PulseX v2 swap fee (amountOut keeps 9971/10000).
computation.ceilingArb: Spread survives the swap fee only when P > B * 1.048038. Still must clear quota, slippage, and gas.
computation.floorArb: Spread survives the swap fee only when P < B * 0.992115. Still must clear slippage and gas.
computation.sizing: Simulate the swap and call previewMint or previewRedeem in the same block. Do not trust this file over those calls. Mint math uses the token's balance increase, not the requested amount, so a fee-on-transfer asset delivers fewer tokens than the argument.
computation.poolRule: PulseX v2 only. If several v2 pairs exist, the deepest wins. One price only. Do not query PulseX v1.

vaultBalance() view returns (uint256) — asset.balanceOf(vault), asset decimals

eventsToWatch: Minted — backing changed because someone entered. newBackingPerToken is WAD-scaled.
Redeemed — backing changed because someone exited.

launcher.index: Call vaultCount(), then vaultsRange(start, count). vaultAt(i) and vaults(i) return one address. Avoid allVaults() once the list is long. Listen for VaultCreated. Then isLaunchVault and infoOf on each address.
abi: function vaultsRange(uint256 start, uint256 count) view returns (address[])
function infoOf(address) view returns (address vault, address creator, address asset, string name, string symbol, uint256 initialQuotaBps, uint256 createdAt, uint256 seedAssetIn, uint256 tokensOut)
function createVault(string name, string symbol, address asset, uint256 initialQuotaBps, uint256 seedAssetIn, uint256 minTokensOut) payable returns (address vault, uint256 tokensOut)

createVault.value: Exactly 10000 ether wei. msg.value != LAUNCH_FEE reverts WrongLaunchFee.
createVault.approve: The creator must approve the factory for seedAssetIn of the backing asset before createVault.
createVault.seed: minSeedAmount(asset) is 10 whole tokens in that asset's decimals.

allowlist.note: Allowlisted backing asset only. Not the USD stable. The contract's symbol() string happens to be DAI. Ignore that string. Price this token as pDAI. Never use it for USD.

lpFeeShare.note: Ownerless drip. Not a farm. LP stays in the wallet. No emission and no promised APR. Rewards exist only if a funder has deposited. A zero pending balance is normal.
lpFeeShare.rewardToken: The vault backing asset. Core pairs pay vPLS or the matching HTT. Launched pairs pay that vault's asset.
lpFeeShare.funders: Core pairs: protocol fee address only. Launched pairs: the vault creator, after register(), and the protocol fee address. Neither funder can claim.
lpFeeShare.boost: 1x at 30 days, then +1x each 30 days, cap 6x at 180 days. Any decrease in LP balance resets the clock and forfeits unclaimed rewards.
lpFeeShare.register: register(vault, pair) requires isLaunchVault, msg.sender == creator, and a PulseX v2 pair. Core pairs are already enrolled.

function earned(address pair, address account) view returns (uint256)
function boostOf(address pair, address account) view returns (uint256)

vouch.note: Not a PulseStrategy contract. PLSstr is backed by vPLS.
vouch.getRate: function getRate() view returns (uint256) — WAD, PLS per 1 vPLS

usdDai.note: USD price only. Not a vault backing asset. Not pDAI.

guarantees: No owner, no admin role, no pause switch, no upgrade path, no proxy on the vaults or the factory.
Backing per token never decreases from any operation of these contracts.
100% of supply is minted publicly through one formula. No pre-mine, no team allocation, no emissions.
risks: No paid third-party audit. Immutable, so a bug is permanent.
The floor is in the vault asset, not USD.
PLSstr inherits Vouch. HEXstr inherits HEX, Hedron HSIs, and Actuator.
A round trip costs about 5% before gas and slippage.
HEXstr holders must exit in two steps at maturity.
Market price may sit at the floor indefinitely.
LP rewards can be zero. Deposit is optional.

errors.meaning: Epoch mint quota exhausted. Wait for timeToNextEpoch or buy on the DEX.
Output fell below the guard. Re-simulate and retry.
Deposit too small to mint one unit.
Input was zero or the transfer delivered nothing.
createVault was not sent exactly 10000 PLS.
Bootstrap mint was under 10 whole tokens of the backing asset.
Factory name already used, ASCII case-insensitive.
Factory symbol already used, ASCII case-insensitive.
Backing asset is not on the six-asset allowlist.
Name or symbol empty, or longer than 32 / 12 chars.
